notes: 02: no remote metadata fetch; title is manually entered, no favicon/description/preview collected. 03: title editable before/after save, but nothing is auto-collected and no description field exists. 04: edit covers url/title/tags only; no description or note fields. 07: list shows title/url/tags but no description and no favicon. 10: tag input is plain comma-separated text with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 12: search covers title/url (and tag names) only; description/note fields do not exist. 14: no #tag search syntax; '#x' is a literal substring that won't match stored tag names. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag or view. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions, and no apply-to-filtered-collection. 22: list is fixed-sorted by created-at desc; no user-selectable sort key. 23: no note field or markdown rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive integration. 26-28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived view. 29: no saved bundles. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user settings (default sort/displayed items/font size).
